findings.failure_path: Evidence gap: the new recovery advice recommends regenerating the ledger, but the packet omits the STALE_LEDGER raise site and render validation. The added test covers stale-ledger recovery only. Thus the required carrier-change → render rejection path, which prevents regeneration from concealing an obligation drop, cannot be verified.
findings.smallest_fix: Include the audit/render validation paths and a regression showing that a changed or removed carrier makes both operations fail without replacing the ledger.

findings.failure_path: Evidence gap: the new generic-controller recipe introduces fresh chain IDs and index 1, but no supplied code shows their admission, challenge or continuation semantics. The new test checks only extraction refusal, so neither the recovery recipe nor the assertion that nothing else reads these fields is verified.
findings.smallest_fix: Include the relevant generic-controller admission and chain-handling context plus a deterministic test of the documented call with its high-risk tag. Remove the unused-field claim unless that context establishes it.

findings.failure_path: Evidence gap: array membership alone does not establish carrier drift → audit failure → failing make test and CI. The packet lacks the audit wrapper, runner dispatch/error propagation, Makefile and CI checkout/job definitions; the reported probes cannot independently establish this acceptance path or existing-suite compatibility.
findings.smallest_fix: Supply those focused wiring excerpts and candidate-bound verification results showing clean success and shifted-carrier failure through the actual fast entrypoints.

findings.failure_path: Evidence gap: the new required local command is presented as reproducing PR CI, but neither the checker's revision/result-selection logic nor CI's invocation is supplied. Consequently, matching the local --base target to the revisions and committed evidence CI examines cannot be verified.
findings.smallest_fix: Include the checker selection logic and PR job invocation, with a parity check covering missing and committed review results.

concern_results.conclusion: The array move and refusal-message change match the intent; end-to-end gate wiring and generic delta admission remain unverified.

The error return remains nonzero; history resolution, pinned-head recovery and render failure handling are outside the packet.
The added tests assert recovery and refusal behavior, but generic-route coverage, gate propagation and candidate-wide regression results are not independently supported.
No flags, schemas or permissions are added. Compatibility of the fast lane's new history requirement remains unverified.
No migration or automatic irreversible operation is introduced; reverting the changes restores the prior placement and diagnostics.
Diagnostics name recovery actions, but omitted implementations prevent confirming those actions' safety and local/CI equivalence.
The claims that rendering cannot hide obligation loss, nothing else reads the chain fields, and the audit adds no duration exceed the supplied source evidence.
The ownership predicate is unchanged. Fresh-chain behavior and preservation of high-risk challenge requirements cannot be checked.
No quoted rule is visibly loosened; supporting context for the new contract command and required candidate-bound validation is missing.
